privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
At Velorze we handle your personal data responsibly and in accordance with applicable regulations (GDPR).

Data we collect: name, email, profile photo, the company or investor data you choose to share, and basic technical data (language, device).

Use: to power the matching service, show your profile to other users when you allow contact, improve the platform, and send service notifications.

We share data only with: infrastructure providers (hosting, authentication, storage) under contract.

Rights: access, rectification, deletion, objection and portability. You can exercise them from Settings or by emailing help@velorze.com.

Retention: while your account is active. When you delete your account we remove your personal data within a reasonable timeframe, unless legally required to retain it.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.body:
Velorze is a discovery and matching platform that connects projects with investors. We do not process payments, manage investments, act as financial intermediaries or provide advice of any kind.

By creating an account you accept these Terms of Use, the Privacy Policy and the Cookie Policy. We keep a record of your acceptance (date, IP and version) for compliance purposes.

Project publishers must complete a verification process. Velorze reserves the right to approve or reject verifications at its discretion.

You agree to: provide truthful information, respect other users, not use the platform for unlawful activities, and take full responsibility for your investment decisions.

Limitation of liability — Velorze does NOT guarantee: (i) the accuracy of identities, (ii) the financial solvency of publishers, (iii) the success of any project, (iv) the outcome of any investment, or (v) user behaviour. Velorze does not provide financial, legal or tax advice.

We may suspend accounts that breach these terms. Use of the service is governed by Spanish law.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.body:
Velorze uses cookies strictly necessary for service operation (session, language, security). These are always loaded.

Analytics and marketing cookies are only activated with your explicit consent, which you can grant, decline or customise from the cookie banner. Your choice is stored on this device and you can change it any time by clearing cookies in your browser.

We do not load analytics or cross-site tracking before your consent.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.body:
Velorze is solely a platform that connects companies with investors. It does not process payments, manage investments, act as a financial intermediary, or provide financial advice. The recommendations generated by the system are purely informational. Users are responsible for performing their own due diligence before making any investment decision.

Identity verification reduces fraud risk but does not guarantee the legitimacy of every investment opportunity published on Velorze. Users remain responsible for carrying out their own due diligence before investing or transferring money.

matching.a: We score each project against your investor profile (sectors, countries, ticket range, investment type). Higher scores mean better fit. Update your profile any time to refine recommendations.

contact.q: How do I contact a company?
contact.a: Open a project and tap Contact company. The company can accept or reject your request. Once accepted, a private chat opens for both of you.

privacy.a: Your contact details are private until you send a contact request. Companies only see what your profile exposes (display name, interests). See our Privacy policy for full details.

account.q: How do I change my email or delete my account?
